verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay has no region or residency selector, and its hosted network says 'no regions to pick.' Its own documented self-hosting does let operators run relays and a private CDN cluster on infrastructure they choose, which decides where data flows. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or region controls, documentation of where data is stored or retained, any residency guarantees for the hosted or 3rd-party CDN, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
